en.topic_title: Hong Kong gov’t defends moving Wang Fuk Court fire tributes on first anniversary of deadly blaze
en.topic_summary:
Floral tributes for the victims of last year’s deadly Wang Fuk Court fire were relocated on Thursday to make room for more mourners, the government has said.



Civil Aid Service personnel rearrange floral tributes near to Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po on the evening of November 26, 2026, one year after a blaze at the complex left 168 people dead. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
